mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.department_id, d.name, d.title, d.gender, d.avatar, d.intro, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time, dep.name AS department_name FROM doctor d LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id WHERE d.id = #{doctorId} AND d.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND s.schedule_date = CURRENT_DATE AND a.status <> 'cancelled'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND s.schedule_date = CURRENT_DATE AND a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'checked_in')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND a.status = 'completed'

SELECT s.id, s.doctor_id, s.schedule_date, s.time_slot, s.total_quota, s.booked_count, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, doc.name AS doctor_name, doc.title AS title, dep.name AS department_name FROM schedule s JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = s.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = doc.department_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.doctor_id = #{doctorId}

SELECT
FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN prescription p ON p.appointment_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND s.doctor_id = #{doctorId}
